cmd.openPanel: Open Chat Panel on the Right
cmd.addToChat: Add Selection to Chat (whole file when nothing is selected)
setting.executablePath: Absolute path to the dsh kernel entry. Leave empty to auto-detect (managed install, then PATH). A .js entry is executed with the VS Code runtime.
setting.preferredVersion: Pins the kernel version for the managed install, e.g. `0.1.2-rc.1`. Applies only to the kernel this extension installs; the kernel is a developer preview, so pinning avoids surprise breaking changes.
setting.acpArgs: Arguments passed when booting the kernel. Defaults to ["--profile", "acp"], which pairs with the profile setting below; no change is needed unless the kernel changes how it boots.
setting.acpProfile: Kernel profile used for ACP sessions. Created on demand via `dsh plugin --profile <name> add @deepseek-ai/dsh-acp-app@<kernel version>`.
setting.acpPluginPackage: Kernel plugin that provides the ACP server. Installed strictly version-paired with the kernel; a mismatch surfaces as a handshake timeout rather than a clear error.
setting.homeDir: Overrides the dsh home directory. Passed to the kernel as the DSH_HOME environment variable, which relocates sessions, credentials and attachments together. Leave empty for the kernel default (~/.dsh). Must be an absolute path.
setting.autoApproveReadOnly: Automatically approve read-only tool calls (read, search, think, fetch) without asking.
setting.attachActiveSelection: Automatically attach the active editor selection as context when sending (unless other context is attached manually).
setting.autoOpenReview: Open the first pending diff automatically when a turn ends with pending changes.
